title: Online Friend Meet-Up
scenario: A gaming friend you have never met asks you to meet after school and keep it secret.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Online Friend Meet-Up: the trap is to turn familiarity or emotion into compliance. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Secret meet-ups with online-only contacts are unsafe.
